figures.finding: A child or adolescent under fifteen may contract to take part in theatre, film, radio, television, circus and like shows only in duly qualified cases, with the competent Family Court's authorisation and article 14's conditions; the employer must protect the child's life and health, fix the hours by the child's best interest, age and maturity, and pay or provide transport and food. From fifteen to seventeen, live shows (not cabarets or bars) need the legal representative's and the Family Court's authorisation; protected adolescent work is at most thirty hours a week, six a day in the school year and eight in holidays, school plus work never over twelve hours a day, no overtime, and no night work in industry or commerce (thirteen hours including 21:00 to 08:00). The minors' rules name shows and participation; whether a young writer or director on set falls under article 16 isn't said, though the Code's arts-and-entertainment chapter counts directors and screenwriters as arts workers.

value.permit: Autorización del Tribunal de Familia (under 15: art. 16; 15-17 in live shows: art. 15 bis, plus the legal representative)
value.under15: qualified cases, hours set by the child's best interest, employer pays transport and food

sources.said: En casos debidamente calificados, cumpliendo con los requisitos del artículo 14 y con la autorización del Tribunal de Familia competente, podrá permitirse a los niños, niñas, y a los adolescentes sin edad para trabajar, que celebren contratos para participar en espectáculos de teatro, cine, radio, televisión, circo u otras actividades similares, debiendo el empleador adoptar las medidas de protección eficaz para proteger su vida y salud física y mental.

Art. 15 bis. Los adolescentes con edad para trabajar podrán actuar en espectáculos vivos que no se desarrollen en cabarets u otros establecimientos similares o en aquellos en que se expendan bebidas alcohólicas que deban ser consumidas en el mismo establecimiento, siempre que cuenten con autorización de su representante legal y del respectivo Tribunal de Familia.

treinta horas semanales, distribuidas en un máximo de seis horas diarias en el año escolar y hasta ocho horas diarias durante la interrupción del año escolar y en el período de vacaciones, … En todo caso, durante el año escolar, la suma total del tiempo diario destinado a actividades educativas y jornada de trabajo no podrá ser superior a doce horas. En ningún caso será procedente el trabajo en jornada extraordinaria.

Se entenderá por trabajadores de artes y espectáculos, entre otros, a los actores de teatro, radio, cine, internet y televisión; … autores, dramaturgos, libretistas, guionistas, doblajistas, compositores

figures.finding: An adolescent of fifteen to seventeen is hired with the written authorisation of the parent with care (failing them, the legal representative, failing them the labour inspector, whose authorisation the Family Court may undo); under fifteen a contract for a show is made with the Family Court's authorisation. No share of earnings must be set aside under the Code. The Family Court route is for shows (art. 16); other creative work by an adolescent follows the general rule.

value.binding: 15-17: written authorisation of the parent(s) with care, else legal representative, else labour inspector (art. 14(b)); under 15: Family Court authorisation (art. 16)

figures.applies: Nationwide; the Civil Code's rules on a minor's own earnings (peculio profesional) weren't read (LeyChile answered 401 in layer 3).

sources.said: b) Contar con autorización por escrito del padre, madre o de ambos que tengan el cuidado personal; o a falta de ellos, de quien tenga el cuidado personal; a falta de éstos, de quien tenga la representación legal del adolescente con edad para trabajar; o a falta de los anteriores, del Inspector del Trabajo respectivo.

figures.finding: The Fondo Audiovisual's screenplay line (2027 contest) admits natural persons of Chilean nationality or foreigners with permanent residence who are over eighteen (and legal persons); a younger writer can't apply in his own name.

figures.finding: SIDARTE, the actors' union, asks a professional for a graduation certificate or title and one by trade for proof of work in productions and twelve months' activity; no age rule is stated on its membership page.

value.byTrade: proof of productions, active the last 12 months

figures.applies: As SIDARTE states it; its statutes weren't read.
